scope: Actual native stream queue producer-completion to exhaustion/admission release; not TTFT, prefill or engine decode throughput.

before.scope: producer completion to stream exhaustion and admission release, not TTFT or decode

after.scope: producer completion to stream exhaustion and admission release, not TTFT or decode

scenarios: implicit final callback then admission release
queued assistant callbacks and explicit finish reason before release
abort interrupts waiting producer and drops late callbacks

build.queue_objects: Old and new src/llm_stream.cpp compiled separately and linked ahead of the same native/core archives. Normalizer and parsing use the actual unchanged native implementation.

limitations: Controlled producer gate allows 10 ms for the consumer to start waiting, then completes without another callback. It isolates EOF notification delay and admission release.
Full 4720 stream helper/generator cases, 96 managed API cases and source lifecycle/ASGI tests remain an integration check for the parent.
No production API or GPU was used.
